resolved.title: 字符串
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Strings[/h1][/s0l0!-header]

We met strings in module 1, but now it’s time to get better acquainted. 

Simply put, if you want to use text in Python, you have to use a [b]string[/b]. But there’s a lot more to it than that, as we’ll find out together!

We can create a [b]string [/b]by entering text between [b]two single or double quotation marks[/b]. Like this:
[code format="py" codeId="3882"]print("Python is fun!")

print('Always look on the bright side of life')[/code]
[note]The delimiter (" or ') used for a string doesn't affect how it behaves in any way.[/note]

content.text:
我们在前面的课程中中认识了字符串，现在让我们学习一些它的高级用法。

简单地说，如果你想在 Python 中使用文本，你必须使用 **字符串**。

我们可以通过在 **''** 或者 **""** 创建一个**字符串**。

示例如下：
content.text_html:
We met strings in module 1, but now it’s time to get better acquainted.

Simply put, if you want to use text in Python, you have to use a string. But there’s a lot more to it than that, as we’ll find out together!

We can create a **string **by entering text between two single or double quotation marks. Like this:

我们在模块1中认识了字符串，但现在是时候让我们更熟悉了。

简单地说，如果你想在 Python 中使用文本，你必须使用字符串。但是还有更多的东西，我们将一起发现!

我们可以通过在两个单引号或双引号之间输入文本来创建一个字符串**。像这样。

content.content:
print("Python is fun!")

print('Always look on the bright side of life')

content.text: 用于字符串的分隔符（"或'）不会以任何方式影响它的行为方式。
content.text_html:
The delimiter (" or ') used for a string doesn't affect how it behaves in any way.

用于字符串的分隔符（"或'）不会以任何方式影响它的行为方式。

resolved.title: 转义符
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Backslash [/h1][/s0l0!-header]

But what if you want to include a single quote in a single-quoted string (or a double quote in a double-quoted string)? Normally this would confuse Python and break the code, that is unless you escape the quotes using a [b]backslash[/b].

[s0l0!-header][b]For Example:[/b][/s0l0!-header][code format="py" codeId="3883"]print('Brian\'s mother: He\'s not an angel. He\'s a very naughty boy!')[/code]
[note]Backslashes that we use for escaping, don’t get displayed in the output.[/note]
